auditScope: all 64 PNGs under character-assets/layers/character in both compared commits

comparison.inspectionPolicy: Every PNG opened at original-resolution equivalent. Identical pairs reused a finding only after byte identity was confirmed; all 29 changed pairs were directly compared at 1:1 scale.

parentSelection.reason: Fewer severe structural regressions and easier remaining local repairs. Current snapshot contains new extra limbs, third-leg residues, duplicated/overlong sticks, and skirt/stool breaks.

frame010.baseline: PASS: coherent two-leg anatomy and normal-length right stick.
frame010.current: FAIL/CRITICAL: overlong right stick, secondary fragment, and central third-leg/vertical residue.
frame010.skirtAssessment: Baseline skirt/waist transition is coherent. Current snapshot is mainly compromised by the central extra-leg/vertical residue; the formerly noted rectangle is not the dominant defect here.
frame010.strikePointAssessment: Exact contact cannot be certified from the isolated character layer. Baseline trajectory is plausible; current stick overshoots a plausible RC target. Fixed-drum composite QA is mandatory.
frame010.rcHitRefreshDonor: rc/hit_r_refresh.png is not a safe direct donor because both versions share its overlong/doubled-stick defect.
